input_text: Flip many coins and heads never lands perfectly half; chance leaves a wobble. Even counting all 2 trillion observable galaxies—one vote each—that wobble remains. The counting floor is the quietest signal a perfect count could hear, not an instrument. Now turn every survival knob to maximum. The budget still lands about 10,000 to 100,000 times below that floor. A whisper beneath a stadium. The Planck regime is the extreme where quantum gravity—gravity's unfinished smallest-scale rules—should matter. One honest caveat: both bounces sit in the Planck regime treated classically, and the strict chain awaits external theorist review.
